subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own an official unsigned iOS archive-producing workflow after the workflow is hardened?
rationale: The security fixes are mechanical, but publishing an unsigned app archive from repository automation is an owner-level CI and distribution policy choice.

options.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
options.body: Repair the workflow hardening defects, rerun the archive proof, and let maintainers decide final acceptance of the official artifact lane.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Leave the successful fork workflow as external proof and do not add an official OpenClaw artifact lane.

options.title: Fold Into Existing CI
options.body: Require the archive behavior to reuse or extend the existing `ios-build` CI surface instead of adding a separate workflow.

recommendation.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
recommendation.body: Repair the workflow hardening defects, rerun the archive proof, and let maintainers decide final acceptance of the official artifact lane.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI and native workflow history makes this the best available owner for the workflow acceptance question.
